scientific_integrity: Two complete exact-integer algorithms, one inclusion-exclusion and one direct cyclotomic transform, agree on all 2187 frequencies and the orbit table. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns the Fano plane with three named colours and excludes larger Steiner triple systems, other palettes, and weighted colourings. Literature comparison cannot rule out unindexed prior computations; one close Fano paper was accessible only at abstract level.
title: Complete ternary Fourier recovery for weak colourings of the Fano plane
